test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate expression that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

The watchman __tried every possible way__ to catch the thief of the hostel.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e., "explored every avenue"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"tried every possible way"** means making every effort or exploring all available options to achieve a goal. (हर संभव प्रयास करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She tried every possible way to convince her parents to let her study abroad.
 
 
 
• **"Explored every avenue" **is the correct substitute phrase, which means considering or trying all possible methods or paths to achieve something. (हर रास्ते की जांच करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The team explored every avenue to find a solution to the technical problem.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct substitution for "tried every possible way" is "explored every avenue."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e., "explored every avenue"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__
 
• **Option 2: Arrived at the eleventh hour **(आखिरी समय में आना): Refers to doing or completing something at the last possible moment.

 
 
• **Example:** She arrived at the eleventh hour to submit her project, just before the deadline.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Cut the cackle **(बातों को रोकना): Means to stop talking aimlessly and get to the point.
 
 
• **Example: **Let’s cut the cackle and discuss the actual problem at hand.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Called it a day **(दिन का काम समाप्त करना): Refers to stopping work or activity for the day.
 
 
• **Example:** After working for hours, they finally called it a day and went home.
